Messages.Author: Dr. Enrique Montaño
Messages.Body:
It sounds like an obvious ans silly question, but it was the point of
the argue last game.

Can you use Skin of Steel in superior even if no damage was done, the
cards text is:

[for] Prevent all damage from the opponent's strike.
[FOR] As above, and prevent all damage from the opponent's strikes for
the remainder of this round.

The card doesn't specify as a requirement that any damage have been
done.
Is this correct?

Enrique

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. If there is no damage, then there is no damage to prevent.
